sentences.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
sentences.zh: 如果货物延误了，我们有特别的延迟保险。

sentences.en: Please disregard this notice if your shipment has already been made.
sentences.zh: 如果您已经发货，请忽略此通知。

sentences.en: Your shipment should be delivered within twenty four hours.
sentences.zh: 您的货物应该在二十四小时内送达。
